rules.latency: original dual-condition warmup; nearest-rank; p99.9 null below 10000 samples
rules.exceedances: strict visible latency > threshold; equality excluded
rules.exposure: first measured actual sent_ns through last measured received_ns
rules.frequency: count / observed exposure minutes; final minute uses actual exposure
rules.minute_buckets: left-closed/right-open, except final observed endpoint is included
rules.minute_trends: actual sent_ns buckets from first to last measured send; original received_ns spike buckets remain unchanged and can differ at boundaries
rules.trend_gate: complete-minute p50 unweighted OLS signed slope <=20us/min and last/first <=1.15; requires complete source run and at least 2 sampled complete minutes
rules.trend_tail: partial/zero-coverage minute displayed only; excluded from OLS and ratio gates
rules.cluster: adjacent exceedance receive gaps <= configured gap form one cluster
rules.cluster_intervals: successive cluster-start receive times; fewer than 5 yields null
rules.interpretation: descriptive only; truncated runs are censored; no periodicity claim

metadata.clock: Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC; nanoseconds; common clock domain across child processes
metadata.build_requirement: release server/extension; commands in baseline report
metadata.pacing: absolute monotonic deadlines; one write outstanding; no dropped slots
metadata.visibility_endpoint: immediately after one-row open_log next(), before to_pylist()
metadata.timestamp_boundary: sent_ns immediately before write; includes Arrow conversion
metadata.background_scope: separate append table in the same namespace and server
